name: IPC Incorrect burn pairs
fix_description: In _destroy, do not directly modify balances[pair] and call sync(). This allows attackers to repeatedly trigger burns from the pair, draining its token balance and manipulating price. Add a per-block rate limit or remove the direct pair balance manipulation entirely.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step flash-loan-based price manipulation involving two DODO flash loans, repeated interaction with a Pancake pair/router loop, and understanding a token-specific burn-on-sell mechanic. While the PoC is not extremely long, it requires protocol-specific reasoning about AMM reserve distortion and callback flow rather than an obvious single-call bug.
